name: io.github.lbailey94/whitemagic-mcp
title: WhiteMagic — governed local memory for agent continuity
description: Governed local-first memory and continuity for AI agents — signed receipts, optional hosted lane.

tools.name: wm
tools.description: Hosted router for available hosted tools. Use tools/list to discover supported routes.

action.description: Legacy hosted action selector. Choose a supported tool from tools/list.

route.description: Explicit hosted tool route. Choose a supported tool from tools/list.

thought.description: Natural language query or command auto-routed via NLU

tools.name: memory.create
tools.description: Store a new memory in the holographic substrate with bijective UUID, 6D projection, and galaxy routing. (READ-ONLY: mutations refused)

event_time.description: Optional event time: when the recorded event actually happened, as RFC 3339

galaxy.description: Target memory galaxy: codex, active, audit, sessions (default: codex)

tools.name: memory.search
tools.description: Search memories: hybrid BM25 + vector fusion with deterministic sub-millisecond retrieval.

cold_scan_limit.description: Maximum cold records to scan when include_cold is set (default 2048)

galaxy.description: Galaxy to search in, or 'all' for cross-galaxy discovery

historical.description: Include superseded or archived records (default: false)

limit.description: Maximum number of memories to return (default: 10)

min_score_ratio.description: Relative floor: reject hits below this fraction of the top score

query.description: Search query or natural language question

since.description: Inclusive lower time bound: RFC3339 or epoch seconds

until.description: Inclusive upper time bound: RFC3339 or epoch seconds

tools.name: memory.temporal_query
tools.description: Query scoped temporal source assertions and their statuses; results are evidence, not verified facts.

known_at.description: Optional offset-bearing RFC3339 knowledge cutoff; forbidden for current, defaults to now for as_of/history.

valid_at.description: Offset-bearing RFC3339 valid time; required for as_of and forbidden for current/history.

tools.name: memory.read
tools.description: Retrieve a specific memory by its numeric record ID or UUID string.

id.description: Unique identifier of the memory (UUID or numeric record_id)

tools.name: memory.list
tools.description: List memories with pagination (limit, offset) and galaxy filtering.

exclude_tags.description: Drop memories carrying any of these tags

galaxy.description: Galaxy to list, or omit for all galaxies

limit.description: Maximum number of memories to return (default: 20)

tools.name: memory.hybrid_recall
tools.description: Compatibility alias of memory.search with BM25 + dense vector fusion.

cold_scan_limit.description: Maximum cold records to scan when include_cold is set (default 2048)

min_score_ratio.description: Relative floor: reject hits below this fraction of the top score

since.description: Inclusive lower time bound: RFC3339 or epoch seconds

until.description: Inclusive upper time bound: RFC3339 or epoch seconds

tools.name: galaxy.list
tools.description: List all active sovereign memory galaxies, their record counts, sample tags, and starter guide status.

tools.name: galaxy.fork
tools.description: Fork an existing galaxy partition into a new sovereign galaxy branch (e.g. 'guide' -> 'project-alpha'). (READ-ONLY: mutations refused)

source.description: Source galaxy name to fork from (e.g. 'guide')

tools.name: galaxy.create
tools.description: Establish a new sovereign galaxy namespace with an initial genesis beacon. (READ-ONLY: mutations refused)

description.description: Optional description of the galaxy's purpose

tools.name: session.record
tools.description: Record a session turn (decision, breakthrough, summary) for compounding continuity. (READ-ONLY: mutations refused)

resolves.description: DiAML turn id of an earlier question, proposal, or hypothesis this turn resolves

supersedes.description: Memory id of an earlier turn this record replaces

tools.name: session.continuity
tools.description: Recall where the previous session left off: recent turns, salient anchors, unresolved DiAML arcs, related track crystals, checkpoints, and open queues.

n.description: Number of recent turns to recall (default: 5)

since.description: Time-range floor: epoch seconds, RFC 3339, or YYYY-MM-DD

token_budget.description: Optional cap for compact agent_context.text: UTF-8 byte cap is token_budget × 4; estimated_tokens is a byte-based heuristic, not tokenizer-guaranteed. Zero produces empty context. Newest checkpoint summary and next_queue are reserved first; if they cannot fit, budget_completeness is insufficient and text is empty.

track.description: Optional track slug to surface prior crystallized codex memories and select the latest prior session on this track

until.description: Time-range ceiling: epoch seconds, RFC 3339, or YYYY-MM-DD

tools.name: session.start
tools.description: Start or resume an agent session for persistent continuity across tool invocations.

tools.name: memory.update
tools.description: Update an existing memory by writing a superseding record (or consolidating into an existing record) and a durable revision entry (prior/new content hashes, timestamp, reason). (READ-ONLY: mutations refused)

content.description: New content for the superseding record (or existing target content when consolidating)

id.description: Memory UUID or numeric record_id to update

reason.description: Optional reason recorded in the revision entry

superseded_by_id.description: Optional existing memory UUID or numeric record_id that supersedes this record

tools.name: memory.revisions
tools.description: List the durable revision chain of a memory, or verify it by recomputing content hashes and chain links.

id.description: Memory UUID or record_id to inspect

tools.name: session.checkpoint
tools.description: Save a structured checkpoint (summary, git state, next queue, open flags, track/lease metadata) for lossless handoffs. (READ-ONLY: mutations refused)

branch.description: Branch name persisted with the checkpoint

commit.description: Commit hash persisted with the checkpoint

crystallize.description: Optional: crystallize converged session decisions into a linked codex memory record (default false)

lease_id.description: Claimed scope lease_id that remains held at this handoff

summary.description: High-density summary of decisions, state, and findings

tests_green.description: Whether the test suite was green at checkpoint time.

track.description: Optional track slug persisted with the checkpoint

tools.name: memory.ingest
tools.description: Ingest inline items (items / items_jsonl / text) or a JSONL/text file (source) via the batch-create path; returns real counts and refuses malformed input. (READ-ONLY: mutations refused)

galaxy.description: Galaxy for items without an explicit source (default: codex)

items.description: Array of items: strings, or objects {content, source?, kind?, tags?, importance?}

items_jsonl.description: Newline-delimited JSONL items, or plain non-empty text lines

redact.description: Scrub credential-shaped tokens before storage (default true).

source.description: Optional path to a JSONL or text file (same line rules as items_jsonl)

tools.name: receipts.emit
tools.description: Emit a signed continuity receipt: kind 'session' signs a digest of the last `limit` session-log turns; kind 'state_transition' signs a store-state snapshot chained to the prior emitted receipt. 'task' receipts are not supported.

out.description: Optional file path to additionally write the receipt JSON

tools.name: receipts.verify
tools.description: Verify one supported WhiteMagic receipt profile (including emitted session/state_transition continuity receipts) against the existing local gate key. This is not a general Continuity Receipt bundle verifier.

bundle.description: One supported signed WhiteMagic profile receipt object

tools.name: memory.count
tools.description: Count memories matching optional filters without returning full payload content.

tools.name: memory.stats
tools.description: Substrate statistics: epoch, total records, relations, postings, and crash-consistency invariants.

tools.name: memory.tags
tools.description: List the tag vocabulary with usage counts.

galaxy.description: Galaxy whose tags to list (optional; default codex)

tools.name: memory.aggregate
tools.description: Aggregate over the matched record set: numeric fields (importance, created_at, epoch) support count/sum/avg/min/max; categorical fields (source, domain, class, status, galaxy) support count only. Unsupported field/op is refused.

field.description: Numeric: importance | created_at | epoch. Categorical (count only): source | domain | class | status | galaxy

metric.description: Alternative metric over matched records: count | session_count | session_span

query.description: Full-text query selecting the memories to aggregate over

tools.name: memory.associations
tools.description: Traverse associative graph neighbours of a memory over hub-penalized multi-hop spreading activation.

hops.description: Spreading activation depth in hops (1 to 3, default: 1)

id.description: Source memory UUID or numeric record_id

tools.name: memory.batch_read
tools.description: Read multiple memories by their UUID or numeric record IDs in a single call.

ids.description: List of memory IDs (UUIDs or integers) to read

tools.name: memory.query
tools.description: Structured query over memories with filters, ordering, and field projections.

created_after.description: Filter: only memories created at or after this RFC 3339 timestamp

created_before.description: Filter: only memories created at or before this RFC 3339 timestamp

tags.description: Filter: memories with all of these tags

tools.name: memory.filter
tools.description: Filter memories by metadata (tags, minimum importance, recency).

created_after.description: Filter: only memories created at or after this RFC 3339 timestamp

created_before.description: Filter: only memories created at or before this RFC 3339 timestamp

exclude_tags.description: Filter: drop memories carrying any of these tags

offset.description: Skip this many matching entries before returning (default 0)

query.description: Filter: every whitespace-separated term must appear

tools.name: memory.pin
tools.description: Durably pin a critical memory against decay, sweep compaction, and forgetting, or release it with pinned=false. (READ-ONLY: mutations refused)

galaxy.description: Optional galaxy this record must belong to (mismatch is refused)

id.description: Memory UUID or numeric record ID to pin

tools.name: memory.search_batch
tools.description: Execute multiple memory search queries concurrently with sub-millisecond retrieval.

tools.name: session.list
tools.description: List session lanes with turn count, last timestamp, latest preview, start-marker flag, and checkpoint presence.

tools.name: session.recall
tools.description: Recall specific interactions and turns within a targeted session (optional content query and limit).

tools.name: session.replay
tools.description: Replay the chronological trajectory of a session: 'full' returns all turns, 'selective' filters by min_importance/turn_types, 'progressive' keeps the most recent turns within token_budget, and 'hybrid' combines earlier high-salience anchor turns (up to 30% of token_budget) with the most recent turns.

current_session_id.description: Optional active session ID to exclude when selecting a prior session automatically

include_superseded.description: Also return turns replaced via supersedes (default false).

since.description: Time-range floor: epoch seconds, RFC 3339, or YYYY-MM-DD

track.description: Optional track slug to select the most recent prior session on this track

turn_types.description: Selective/hybrid mode: turn types to keep

until.description: Time-range ceiling: epoch seconds, RFC 3339, or YYYY-MM-DD

tools.name: session.digest
tools.description: Compose a digest from typed session-log turns and the latest checkpoint (markdown text plus JSON, with optional codex crystallization).

crystallize.description: Optional: crystallize converged session decisions into a linked codex memory record (default false)

tools.name: mandala.status
tools.description: Status of the Mandala microsecond Landlock sandbox, ABI level, POSIX rlimit bounds, and capability ledger.

tools.name: mandala.triage
tools.description: Non-autoregressive System 1 JEV/Layla triage gate (<30 ns) to classify tasks and predict marginal utility and confinement tier.

inquiry.description: Task or inquiry description to triage

tools.name: mandala.evaluate
tools.description: Execute a candidate mutation in an ephemeral Landlock sandboxed Kekkai and notarize with Spec 0.5 receipt. (READ-ONLY: mutations refused)

candidate_id.description: Unique identifier for the mutation candidate

command.description: Optional command to execute within ephemeral sandbox

tools.name: mesh_sync
tools.description: Synchronize the Substrate with a remote peer node over the sovereign TCP protocol.

tools.name: gnosis.status
tools.description: System epistemics, self-model calibration, and invariant health status.

tools.name: gnosis.explain
tools.description: Explain internal architectural invariants, memory schemas, or routing logic.

args_hash.description: Hash of the arguments under evaluation

has_purpose.description: Claim: the invocation carries a purpose

is_network.description: Claim: the invocation uses the network

is_spawn.description: Claim: the invocation spawns a process

tools.name: decision.shortlist
tools.description: Rank candidate routes/actions for a state with the local static-embedding retrieval organ (no network, no model forward pass) and emit a signed shortlist receipt. (READ-ONLY: mutations refused)

cascade.description: If ambiguous, cascade to System 1.5 Deliberator (default true)

catalog_path.description: Path to a JSON file with {name: description}; used when `routes` is absent

emit_receipt.description: Write a signed shortlist receipt to <store>/receipts (default true)

margin_threshold.description: Below this top1-top2 margin the gate is 'ambiguous' (default 0.02)

routes.description: Candidate set: {name: description} or {name: [utterances...]}; multi-utterance routes score by best match

session_id.description: Session id for the shortlist receipt

state.description: State to retrieve candidates for (text or JSON)

tenant_id.description: Tenant id for the shortlist receipt (default: local)

tools.name: decision.deliberate
tools.description: Deliberate over ambiguous candidate options using local grammar-constrained SLM inference (100% schema guarantee, no hallucination) and emit a signed deliberation receipt. (READ-ONLY: mutations refused)

candidates.description: Allowed candidate action names, objects, or map

emit_receipt.description: Write signed deliberation receipt to <store>/receipts (default true)

tools.name: decision.outcome
tools.description: Sign and journal the outcome of a dispatched decision/shortlist receipt (success, failure, corrected) for the learning loop. (READ-ONLY: mutations refused)

corrected_route.description: Correct route when the outcome is 'corrected'

receipt_path.description: Path to the subject receipt JSON under <store>/receipts

tools.name: sutra.cast
tools.description: Evaluate and dispatch a zero-allocation Taoist Hand Seal / Sutra Codon (e.g. '觀 證 行', 'Kek-01-Seal'). Validates preconditions, computes Kekkai sandbox boundaries, and executes bound Action Skeleton cycles or transmits swarm mudra packet to P2P peer. (READ-ONLY: mutations refused)

codon.description: Logoglyphic Sutra codon or Taoist hand seal sequence (e.g. '觀 證 行', 'Kek-01-Seal', '根 界 息')

dry_run.description: Alias for !execute; if true, only validates preconditions and returns deterministic plan

execute.description: Whether to execute the bound Action Skeleton against the substrate (default: false / dry-run)

peer.description: Target peer address (e.g. '152.53.195.47:7369') for remote Swarm Mudra Handoff via Wire Protocol 7369

resolves.description: Optional DiAML turn ID resolved by this Sutra execution (defaults to latest open arc when omitted)

session_id.description: Optional session ID to record the executed Sutra DiAML turn into

strict.description: Fails closed if preconditions (read-only, landlock, mesh net) are unsatisfied

track.description: Optional track slug for the recorded Sutra turn

tools.name: sutra.compile
tools.description: Compile high-level natural language intent into an optimal compound Sutra codon and Taoist Mudra formula using static Model2Vec embeddings or lexical centroids.

query.description: High-level natural language intent or task description to compile into a Sutra codon

tools.name: sutra.canon
tools.description: Inspect the canonical 12-glyph logoglyphic Sutra canon, alchemical dual-mappings, Taoist hand seals (印诀), and bound Action Skeletons.

tools.name: sutra.list
tools.description: List all recognized canonical compound Taoist Mudras (印诀式), their formulaic compositions, preconditions, and primary execution skeletons.

tools.name: sutra.hexagram
tools.description: Inspect or mutate one of the 64 King Wen I Ching Hexagram Macro-Actions. Returns King Wen number, binary symbol, trigrams, Wu Xing element, default codon, nuclear inner, complement (反), reverse (覆), and dynamic line mutation transformations.

mutate_line.description: Optional line number (1 to 6, bottom to top) to mutate (flip yin/yang) and compute resulting hexagram and codon

query.description: Hexagram name, pinyin, King Wen number (1-64), or Unicode symbol (e.g. '既济', 'Qian', '1', '䷾')

tools.name: sutra.route
tools.description: Route an inquiry or task intent through the Catuṣkoṭi K3 dialectical cognitive router. Employs Kleene 3-valued logic to resolve dialectical tensions (competing action vectors like execute vs dry-run) and matches 64-hexagram macro-actions, returning System 0/1/2 triage tier, resting potential, plasticity, and bound Action Skeleton.

inquiry.description: Task description, inquiry, or hexagram name to route

tools.name: sutra.contract
tools.description: Resolve or verify bounded caller-asserted temporal assertions. Results describe the supplied metadata; this tool does not authenticate sources or enforce native-store sanctuary access.

assertions.description: Caller-asserted records with record_id, source_id, subject, predicate, value, valid_from, valid_until, recorded_at, supersedes; exclude when request_json is supplied

attest.description: Return an unsigned SHA-256 digest binding the operation, exact request bytes and result; not a signature or CPR receipt

mode.description: Contract operation: resolve assertions into facts/citations or verify a candidate proposal (default: resolve)

proposal.description: Candidate proposal object (for verify mode) with status and claims array

question.description: Question object with question_id, query, subject, predicate, valid_at (array of dates), and known_at cutoff

request_json.description: Full raw request JSON; mutually exclusive with assertions, question and proposal

tools.name: legion.summon
tools.description: [Experimental / Simulation] Run a deterministic Rayon stack-codon cohort simulation across CPU cores. Evaluates N candidate codon variants across four archetypes (Adversarial, Refactor, Speculative Replay, Horizon Stress) and classifies heuristic outcomes via Cho-Han (丁半). Scores and token-budget deltas are modeled estimates, not measured LLM execution.

clones.description: Number of volatile shadow clones to summon (default: 32, max: 128)

edict.description: Imperial edict codon or Taoist hand seal sequence to dispatch across the shadow clone legion (e.g. '⟪ 通 · 照 · 合 · 證 ⟫', '三家归元印')

peer.description: Optional remote peer address (e.g. '152.53.195.47:7369') for cross-node Gap Junction Wire Protocol 7369 handoff

tools.name: chohan.settle
tools.description: [Experimental / Simulation] Classify a payload or proof string into Cho (丁 / even / pass) or Han (半 / odd / anomaly). Advisory string/parity classification only; does not independently verify execution proofs or perform on-chain escrow.

bid.description: Advisory stake label in micro-USDC (default: 10000; not escrowed)

payload.description: Claim, evaluation payload, or state representation to adjudicate

proof.description: Optional proof label or invariant note

tools.name: valkyrie.pulse
tools.description: Execute a 12-Phase Tricameral Valkyrie-2 pulse (`Valkyrie-0` 1.58-bit Ternary + `RWKV-7` Delta-Rule 28-Gana Router + Cross-Layer Sparse Transcoder Attribution Graph + `Valkyrie-1` Corpus Callosum Fusion + Tsao 15 Hz Working-Memory Ring + Citadel Antibody Gate + Hardware Thermal Telemetry), or run the full real-world corpus & world model benchmark (`benchmark=true`).

benchmark.description: If true, runs the real-world 384-D X bookmark + 512-D Model2Vec Sutra + 4,133 Citadel antibody benchmark battery

digest.description: Optional 64-bit candidate signature digest to test against the CitadelAntibodyBloom2048 immune filter

inquiry.description: Natural language inquiry or Sutra codon to evaluate through Valkyrie-2

tools.name: service.request_eval_key
tools.description: Request a free evaluation API key in-band. Keyd applies persistent per-client-IP and global daily issuance limits. The returned key's recall and optional write-sample terms are read from the authoritative key record. Pass it as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' on subsequent calls.

agent_id.description: Optional agent identifier for issuance attribution (max 64 chars, sanitized).

ref.description: Optional referral/channel tag for issuance attribution (max 64 chars, sanitized).

tools.name: economy_advance
tools.description: Request a small uncollateralized compute advance. Phase 1 (2026-10-15): bound to your authenticated evaluation key (daily per-IP and global caps); new key identities start at a $0.10 ceiling that grows $0.25 per verified settled payment. Returns a recall-scope session pass; hosted write requires a paid lease.

agent_id.description: EVM address, agent public key, or unique agent identifier.

amount.description: Requested advance in USD (default 0.01, max 0.05 per advance; clamped to available credit).

request_key.description: Set to true to atomically provision an evaluation key and advance if calling without an existing authenticated key.

tools.name: economy_settle
tools.description: Settle outstanding compute balance to upgrade Bayesian reputation score and dynamically expand credit ceiling. Supports payment reference or gasless EIP-3009 transfer authorization.

amount.description: Amount in USD to settle (omit to settle entire outstanding balance).

payment_reference.description: Payment receipt, transaction hash, or off-chain authorization reference.

eip3009.description: Optional gasless EIP-3009 authorization signature payload (from, to, value, validAfter, validBefore, nonce, v, r, s).

tools.name: economy_ledger
tools.description: Inspect public transparency metrics: total loans disbursed, default rates, zero predatory liquidation policy, and sovereign free invariants.

tools.name: economy_chohan_arbitrate
tools.description: Advisory contention tie-breaker only. It does not acquire or enforce locks, uses a post-hoc recomputable SHA-256 draw, and is not host-bias-proof.

resource_id.description: Resource lock name, file path, or task identifier.

candidates.description: List of contender agent IDs competing for the lock (2 or more).

agent_a.description: Contender A (used if candidates array omitted).

agent_b.description: Contender B (used if candidates array omitted).

client_seed.description: Optional client entropy for a post-hoc recomputable SHA-256 draw; there is no prior commitment or host-bias proof.

client_seeds.description: Optional list or mapping of caller entropy; used as input to a post-hoc recomputable draw.

bids.description: Optional finite positive caller-claimed weights for a weighted lottery; no stake custody or settlement occurs.

tools.name: economy_chohan_roll
tools.description: Advisory SHA-256 dice draw. The server seed is disclosed with the result; there is no prior commitment or host-bias proof.

bet.description: Optional choice ('cho' for even sum, 'han' for odd sum).

tools.name: citadel_threat_intel
tools.description: Query zero-cost, real-time threat intelligence and hostile-source indicators captured by the Citadel deception mesh. Pass 'lookup' (an IP address, subnet prefix, or SSH HASSH fingerprint) for target analysis, or omit 'lookup' for the latest rolling attack telemetry, campaign clusters, and advisory subnets.

lookup.description: Optional IP address (IPv4/IPv6), subnet prefix, or SSH HASSH fingerprint to query against the hostile indicator set.

export.description: Export mode. 'summary' (default) returns high-level posture; 'full' returns complete active indicator set and campaign clusters.

bulk.description: Set to true to export all current hostile IP indicators, honeypot telemetry, and firewall rules.
